title: Yoda
description: YODA, the Jedi Master, is a 900-year-old being who began training Jedi Knights when he was 100. Despite his better judgement, he agrees to train yet another in the ways of the Force: Luke Skywalker. For he knows that despite Luke's anger and impatience, the young Skywalker is capable of overthrowing Ihe Ernperor. "Try not," Yoda tells a frustrated Luke, who is ready to abandon training. "Do. Or do not. There is no try."
